'''Aola''' was a substance that could be used to cook [[scalefish fillets]] and flash-fry [[Tip-yip/Legends|Endorian chicken]]. The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] sold [[fried Endorian chicken]] and [[scalefish]] fillets, both cooked in aola, at his [[Dex's Diner/Legends|diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />   

==Behind the scenes==
Aola was first mentioned in the script for the ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> released in [[1978]];<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref> however, the mention was ultimately cut from the special.<ref name="Holiday Special" /> The special's script indicated that substance would have appeared in the pre-taped cooking section of the special with the [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] chef [[Gormaanda/Legends|Gormaanda]] brushing aola on to her [[Bantha/Legends|bantha loin]] while preparing [[Bantha Surprise]].<ref name="Script">The forth draft of the ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' script was posted to a fansite {{WebCite|url=http://www.starwarsholidayspecial.com/swhs-old/text/script.htm|text=The Fourth Draft Script - 09/13/78|archivedate=20251119085058}}</ref> Aola was later mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
